eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 4:18 PM on AUG 24, 2023 Effective until 4:18 PM AUG 25, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Beauregard Parish Sheriffs Office is ordering a mandatory evacuation for the Town of Merryville and surrounding area due to approaching fire. This notice affects all residents and businesses. The fire could reach town limits within the next hour to two hours. Highways 389 and 110 is closed. 190W must be used to evacuate. Relocate as instructed in the CAP alert
